response.original_title: Atomic Pilgrimage: Ghost Towns, Nuclear Relics, and Lost Civilizations on the Road to the Trinity Site
response.overview: A 40-day, 40-night road trip to the Trinity Site-where the first atomic bomb was detonated in the summer of 1945-covering many other atomic destinations and driving deep into the natural and social history of the American southwest.
response.title: Atomic Pilgrimage: Ghost Towns, Nuclear Relics, and Lost Civilizations on the Road to the Trinity Site
